RedWallet XBT 8.0.1 (1792686194) — Kilojoin v4

CoinJoin under Settings > Tools now supports compatible v3 single-output pools and v4 pools with 2–5 equal mixed outputs per participant, with fresh receiving addresses and separate blinded output registration. Built in collaboration with Kilombino's Kilojoin protocol.

Includes CoinJoin join/recovery fixes, native entropy and protected identity-storage checks, corrected optional artwork framing, pool discovery progress/errors, and the combined wallet/security improvements.

CoinJoin remains Experimental and requires explicit live opt-in. Review amounts, recipients and fees before signing. Mixing does not guarantee anonymity; the relay can see your IP and your configured backend can see address queries. Reserved coins and change require the displayed recovery/confirmation steps.

Use a fresh wallet and small test amounts. Hosted iOS and funded regtest tests passed; this does not establish physical-device, ColdWallet, or full mainnet CoinJoin interoperability. Coin color labels and automatic privacy-aware suggestions are not included in this build.
